The same-value adoption boundary should receive regression coverage. The added adoption test exercises only a differing value, leaving adoption’s unconditional change recording and resulting file rewrite unprotected.

## Important
- app/config.py:15 — tests — Adopting `{"theme": "dark"}` into a file already containing `{"theme":"dark"}` has no test protecting the returned change list or resulting file contents. The adoption branch unconditionally records the key and triggers serialization, while the existing same-value test exercises only replacement. Add a same-value adoption test asserting the recorded key and resulting file bytes. — Regressions in adoption’s behavior for already matching settings could pass the current tests.
